title: write_config materialises defaults into config.json, so writing a default stops it being a default and the project silently stops tracking the tool
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names -- so its finding survived only in the commit that filed it. The prose below is its author's, carried whole from `be976f9d` (*issue(0091): writing a default stops it being a default, and nothing in the file says which values were chosen*). **Nothing in it is written by the restorer**; the header you are reading is the only addition, and the commit's hard line wraps are joined without a word changed.

cc found this landing lang, wrote it durably to vc/inbox.cc.md before sending it, and deliberately did not fix it -- it is project.rs behaviour reaching every future writer and the remedy is a trade-off rather than a tidy-up.

Reproduced independently before filing rather than taken on report. A four-key config.json came back from intent3 lang init rust with seven: author, intent_dir and todo materialised, todo arriving as window_hours 24. Config uses serde(default) with no skip_serializing_if on four fields.

My count disagreed with cc's -- four in and seven out against cc's four and eight -- and the difference is recorded rather than smoothed: my fixture already carried project_name, one of the four materialised, so only three were added. Same property, different arithmetic. Two figures for one measurement with no record of why is the defect this project keeps finding in its own documents.

The correct half was confirmed in the same run: an unmodelled block survived byte-for-byte, as extra's doc promises. This is the opposite direction -- not a block dropped, a default frozen.

Inert today, and that is the whole difficulty. Every value written is the value the tool would have used, so nothing observable differs and no test can fail. The cost is deferred to the first default change, by which time the divergence is installed across all seventeen projects and is silent by construction. v2 did not do this; it used jq and left the rest of the file alone.

Three remedy shapes recorded, including one neither of us proposed first: record provenance so a materialised value is distinguishable from a chosen one, which is the only shape that keeps both properties.
